items.title: 关系代词 who/whom/whose 的选用
items.brief: 指人时看从句缺主语、宾语还是定语

concept.summary: 定语从句选关系词走四步：先确定先行词指人还是指物；再看从句缺什么成分，缺主语或宾语用关系代词，缺状语用关系副词；再看是否限定性；最后看有没有介词提前。先行词指人时，缺主语用 who，缺宾语用 whom（口语可用 who 或 that），缺定语用 whose。

sections.p: 四步按顺序走，每步都有可判定的依据，走完之后关系词的候选范围只剩一个。判定成分的方法是把先行词代回从句：代回后作主语就是缺主语，作宾语就是缺宾语，后有名词需要限定就是缺定语。
bullets: 第一步 先行词：指人 → who/whom/whose；指物 → which/that；指时间、地点、原因 → 先假设关系副词
第二步 缺什么成分：代回后作主语 → who；作宾语 → whom；后面紧跟名词且表所属 → whose
第三步 是否限定性：非限定性从句不用 that，指人也不能用 that
第四步 介词：介词提到关系词前，指人只能用 whom，指物只能用 which

sections.p: whom 只能作宾语，因此它是否出现取决于宾语的位置是否显著。介词之后、非限定性从句之中、以及数量词 + of 的结构里，whom 不可替换为 who。其余场合的口语与一般书面语中，who 或 that 作宾语是正常用法。
bullets: 介词 + whom：the colleague with whom I share an office
非限定性从句作宾语：The dean, whom I met last week, agreed to fund the project.
数量词 + of whom：twenty applicants, three of whom were shortlisted
限定性从句作宾语且无介词：the man (who/that) I met yesterday，关系词可以省略

sections.p: whose 的唯一功能是把先行词与后面的名词连接成所属关系，后面的名词前不再加 the、my 这类限定词。whose 既能指人也能指物，指物时等于 of which，可以互换。
bullets: 指人：a writer whose novels sell millions of copies
指物：a house whose roof leaks = a house the roof of which leaks
whose + 名词整体可在从句中作主语、宾语或介词宾语：in whose honour the party was held

examples.en: The engineer who designed the bridge received a national award.
examples.zh: 设计这座桥的工程师获得了国家级奖项。
examples.note: 从句缺主语，先行词指人，用主格 who。

examples.en: The engineer whom we interviewed yesterday has left the company.
examples.zh: 我们昨天面试的那位工程师已经离开公司了。
examples.note: 从句缺宾语，正式书面语用宾格 whom。

examples.en: The engineer with who we signed the contract has retired.
examples.zh: 与我们签合同的那位工程师已经退休。
examples.note: 介词 with 后必须用宾格 whom，who 不能作介词宾语，应改为 with whom。

examples.en: The student who father teaches chemistry is my cousin.
examples.zh: 父亲教化学的那个学生是我表弟。
examples.note: 从句中 father 前缺少所有格限定词，应用 whose father，who 不能表示所属。

examples.en: She has a brother whose ambition is to become a pilot.
examples.zh: 她有个弟弟，他的志向是成为飞行员。
examples.note: whose 连接先行词 brother 与名词 ambition，表示“他的志向”。

examples.en: They moved into an old cottage whose windows face the sea.
examples.zh: 他们搬进了一座窗户朝海的旧农舍。
examples.note: whose 指物，等于 the windows of which，因此后面不再加定冠词。

examples.en: Twenty candidates applied, three of whom were invited to interview.
examples.zh: 二十名候选人提交了申请，其中三人获邀面试。
examples.note: 数量词 + of whom 是书面语中关系词作介词宾语的固定结构。

pitfalls.wrong: The girl who mother is a nurse sits next to me.
pitfalls.right: The girl whose mother is a nurse sits next to me.
pitfalls.why: 从句中 mother 前缺少限定词，先行词与 mother 是所属关系，只能由 whose 承接。

pitfalls.wrong: The professor to who I sent my paper replied within a day.
pitfalls.right: The professor to whom I sent my paper replied within a day.
pitfalls.why: 介词 to 已提到关系词之前，介词宾语必须用宾格 whom。

pitfalls.wrong: The candidate whom won the election promised to cut taxes.
pitfalls.right: The candidate who won the election promised to cut taxes.
pitfalls.why: 从句缺主语，whom 只能作宾语，主格位置必须换成 who。

contrast.withTitle: 关系代词 that 与 which 的区别
contrast.diff: 本知识点解决指人时主格、宾格、所有格的分工；that 与 which 的分工由先行词类型、修饰语和限定性决定，与格无关。

concept.mnemonic: 指人先问缺什么：主语 who，宾语 whom，后面紧跟名词就是 whose。

core: 四步流程：先行词 → 从句缺什么成分 → 限定性 → 介词搭配
who 作主语；whom 只作宾语，介词后与非限定性从句中不能换成 who
whose + 名词表所属，指人指物皆可，指物等于 of which
数量词 + of whom 用于非限定性从句，表整体中的一部分
限定性从句作宾语且无介词时，口语可用 who 或 that，也可以省略
review.trigger: 看到先行词指人 → 把先行词代回从句 → 缺主语填 who，缺宾语填 whom，后面紧跟名词填 whose

quickCheck.q: The man ___ car was stolen called the police. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: whose，从句缺的是修饰 car 的所有格限定词。

quickCheck.q: 介词后面的关系代词指人时用哪个形式？
whom 能作从句主语吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，whom 只有宾格功能。

drills.stem: The journalist ___ articles appear in several national newspapers will speak at the forum.
drills.answer: whose
drills.explain: 从句的谓语是 appear，主语是 articles，空格处需要的是修饰 articles 的所有格限定词，只有 whose 能承担这一功能。
drills.trap: 选 who 会让从句出现 articles 与 appear 两个主语，句子结构崩掉；which 指物，与指人的先行词不符。

drills.stem: The consultant with ___ we signed the contract is based in Singapore.
drills.answer: whom
drills.hint: 介词 with 已经提到关系词前面。
drills.explain: sign a contract with sb 是固定搭配，介词 with 提前后必须接宾格，指人用 whom，构成 with whom。

drills.stem: The pianist who performance impressed the judges is only seventeen.
drills.answer: The pianist whose performance impressed the judges is only seventeen.
accept: The pianist whose performance impressed the judges is only seventeen.
drills.explain: performance 前缺少限定词，先行词 pianist 与 performance 构成所属关系，关系词须用 whose。

drills.stem: The delegate ___ the committee spoke was elected chairman of the board.
drills.answer: to whom
drills.explain: speak to sb 是固定搭配，从句中的介词 to 不能省略；介词提到关系词前，指人须用宾格 whom。
drills.trap: to who 把主格 who 放在介词后，介词宾语只能用宾格；只填 whom 则让 spoke 失去介词，语义不完整。

drills.stem: 我昨天采访的那位工程师曾在德国工作。
drills.answer: The engineer whom I interviewed yesterday once worked in Germany.
drills.explain: 先行词指人且从句缺宾语，用 whom；interview 后已带宾语 whom，不能再加 him。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The girl whose father teaches chemistry is my cousin.
drills.explain: whose father 在从句中作主语，teaches chemistry 是谓语和宾语，is my cousin 是主句的系表结构。

items.title: 关系代词 that 与 which 的区别
items.brief: 三类硬条件决定 that 与 which 的取舍

concept.summary: that 与 which 指物时多数场合可互换，取舍靠三类硬条件：先行词为不定代词或被 only、very、same、last、序数词、最高级修饰时只能用 that；介词提前或从句为非限定性时只能用 which；其余限定性从句两者皆可，非限定性从句绝对不用 that。

sections.h: 只能用 that 的四类先行词
sections.p: 这四类条件的共同点是先行词的范围被压到极窄或极不确定，that 在这种语境中承担“唯一指向”的功能。判定时先查先行词本身，再看它的修饰语。
bullets: 不定代词作先行词：all, everything, anything, nothing, little, much, none, few
被 the only / the very / the same / the last / 序数词 / 最高级修饰：the best film that I have seen
被 all / every / any / no / some 等限定词修饰：all the work that was assigned
先行词同时包含人与物：the people and the places that impressed us
主句以 who 或 which 开头，避免重复：Who is the girl that is standing by the door?

sections.h: 只能用 which 的三类结构
sections.p: 这三条与先行词无关，只与结构位置有关：介词之后、逗号之后、以及先行词本身是 that 或 those 的场合。前两条是高频考点，第三条出现频率低但规则明确。
bullets: 介词提前：the room in which he lives，介词后不能用 that
非限定性从句：逗号之后绝不用 that
先行词本身是 that 或 those：What is that which he is holding?
流程位置：先行词 → 成分 → 限定性（即“逗号后”）→ 介词（即“介词提前”），两条 which 专属条件正是后两步的产物

sections.p: 限定性从句中两条硬条件都不触发时，that 更口语、更紧凑，which 更正式。同一句里已经出现 that 作指示代词或连词时，改用 which 可以避免重复；先行词与从句被较长成分隔开时，which 的指向更清楚。
bullets: The letter that arrived this morning is from my old teacher.
The letter which arrived this morning is from my old teacher.
两个句子语法都成立，差别只在语体，考点通常落在前两条硬条件上

examples.en: All that glitters is not gold.
examples.zh: 闪光的不都是金子。
examples.note: 先行词 all 是不定代词，关系代词只能用 that。

examples.en: All which glitters is not gold.
examples.zh: 闪光的不都是金子。
examples.note: 不定代词 all 后不能接 which，应改为 that。

examples.en: This is the only copy that the library still keeps.
examples.zh: 这是图书馆仍然保存的唯一一本。
examples.note: 先行词被 the only 修饰，关系代词用 that。

examples.en: The village in which she grew up has become a tourist attraction.
examples.zh: 她长大的那个村庄已经成了旅游景点。
examples.note: 介词 in 提前，指物只能用 which。

examples.en: The village in that she grew up has become a tourist attraction.
examples.zh: 她长大的那个村庄已经成了旅游景点。
examples.note: 介词后的关系代词不能用 that，应改为 in which。

examples.en: He showed me the photos and the letters that he had kept for years.
examples.zh: 他给我看了他保存多年的照片和信件。
examples.note: 先行词同时包含物与人，只能用 that 覆盖两者。

examples.en: The novel, that was published in 1925, is still widely read.
examples.zh: 这部小说出版于1925 年，至今仍被广泛阅读。
examples.note: 逗号后是非限定性从句，that 不能引导非限定性从句，应改为 which。

pitfalls.wrong: Everything which he said was recorded.
pitfalls.right: Everything that he said was recorded.
pitfalls.why: 先行词是复合不定代词 everything，关系代词只能用 that。

pitfalls.wrong: The house in that I was born has been pulled down.
pitfalls.right: The house in which I was born has been pulled down.
pitfalls.why: 介词 in 已提到关系词前，介词宾语只能用 which，that 不能作介词宾语。

pitfalls.wrong: The Great Wall, that attracts millions of tourists, dates back to ancient times.
pitfalls.right: The Great Wall, which attracts millions of tourists, dates back to ancient times.
pitfalls.why: 逗号后为非限定性从句，that 一律不进入这一结构。

contrast.withTitle: 限制性与非限制性定语从句
contrast.diff: 本知识点只解决限定性从句里 that 与 which 的取舍；是否加逗号、从句能否删除由限制性判定决定，一旦是非限定性，that 直接出局。

concept.mnemonic: 不定代词、only、最高级、人物混合 → 只认 that；介词前、逗号后 → 只认 which。

core: 只能用 that：先行词为不定代词、被 only/very/same/last/序数词/最高级修饰、人物混合、主句以 who/which 开头
只能用 which：介词提前、非限定性从句、先行词为 that 或 those
非限定性从句绝不用 that，这条没有例外
限定性从句中两者皆可时，that 偏口语，which 偏正式
介词 + that 是硬错，介词后只能接 which 或 whom
review.trigger: 看到指物的先行词 → 先查三条 that 专属条件 → 再看有没有逗号和提前的介词 → 都不触发才谈互换

quickCheck.q: 先行词是 everything 时用 that 还是 which？
the only 修饰先行词时关系词用什么？
非限定性从句能用 that 吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，只能用 which 或 who。

drills.stem: This is the only reference book ___ the library keeps on open shelves.
drills.answer: that
drills.explain: 先行词被 the only 修饰，属于 that 的专属条件；which 在这种结构中不规范，what 不能引导定语从句。
drills.trap: which 在普通限定性从句中确实可以替代 that，但 the only 修饰先行词时规范用法只接受 that。

drills.stem: The village in ___ she grew up has become a popular tourist attraction.
drills.answer: which
drills.hint: 介词 in 已经提到空格前面。
drills.explain: 介词 in 提前后只能接 which，构成 in which；that 不能作介词宾语。

drills.stem: The Great Wall, that attracts millions of visitors every year, dates back to ancient times.
drills.answer: The Great Wall, which attracts millions of visitors every year, dates back to ancient times.
accept: The Great Wall, which attracts millions of visitors every year, dates back to ancient times.
drills.explain: 专有名词后的从句只能是限定性以外的补充说明，即非限定性从句，而非限定性从句不能用 that。

drills.stem: He told us about the people and the customs ___ he had observed during his stay.
drills.answer: that
drills.explain: 先行词同时包含人 the people 与物 the customs，which 只能指物、who 只能指人，只有 that 能覆盖两者。
drills.trap: which 是最强干扰项，它只覆盖 the customs，会让 the people 失去关系词。

drills.stem: 他所说的一切都被记录了下来。
drills.answer: Everything that he said was recorded.
drills.explain: 先行词 everything 是不定代词，关系代词只能用 that；what 本身已包含先行词，不能再与 everything 并用。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: This is the best film that I have ever seen.
drills.explain: 先行词被最高级 best 修饰，关系代词用 that；that 在从句中作 seen 的宾语。

items.title: as 与 which 引导定语从句的区别
items.brief: 位置定 as，语义分“正如”与“这一点”

concept.summary: as 与 which 都能引导非限定性定语从句指代整个主句，判据有两条：位置——as 从句可放在句首、句中、句末，which 从句只能跟在主句之后；语义——as 意为“正如”，表示从句内容与主句一致或为人们熟知，which 意为“这一点”，对主句事实作出评论或说明结果。

sections.p: which 从句在结构上依附于前面的主句，因此不能出现在句首；as 从句位置自由，句首是它最典型的落点。两句话意思相同，能否放在句首直接决定用哪个词。
bullets: 句首：As is often the case, he arrived without his notes.
句中：The plan, as we had expected, was approved.
句末：He was late again, as he often is.
which 只能跟在主句后：He was late again, which annoyed the teacher.
流程位置：先行词与成分两步已确定从句指代整句，位置与语义只用来在 as 与 which 之间二选一

sections.p: as 表示“正如”，从句内容是对主句的印证，常与 know、say、expect、report、mention 等动词的被动式或 be often the case 搭配；which 表示“这一点”，从句对主句作出评价、补充或说明结果。语义判据用来处理位置判据不起作用的情形，即两者都位于主句之后时。
bullets: as 的固定搭配：as is well known / as we all know / as has been said above / as is often the case
which 的评论谓语：which is why... / which made him angry / which shows that...
as 从句不承担“导致、说明”这类评论功能，出现这类谓语时用 which

sections.p: as 还能在限定性从句中与 the same、such 呼应。这时不涉及位置判据，只靠语义区分：the same...that 指同一物，the same...as 指同类物。
bullets: This is the same book that I borrowed last week.（同一本）
This is the same book as I borrowed last week.（同样的书，不是同一本）
Such problems as you describe are common among beginners.

examples.en: As is often the case with beginners, she makes a few spelling mistakes.
examples.zh: 正如初学者常有的情况，她犯了几个拼写错误。
examples.note: as 从句置于句首，表示“正如”，which 不能出现在这个位置。

examples.en: Which is often the case with beginners, she makes a few spelling mistakes.
examples.zh: 正如初学者常有的情况，她犯了几个拼写错误。
examples.note: which 引导的非限定性从句不能置于句首，应改为 As。

examples.en: He missed the last train, which meant he had to walk home.
examples.zh: 他错过了末班车，这意味着他只能走回家。
examples.note: which 指代整个主句，说明结果，从句位于主句之后。

examples.en: He missed the last train, as meant he had to walk home.
examples.zh: 他错过了末班车，这意味着他只能走回家。
examples.note: 从句在说明主句造成的结果，属于“这一点”的评论语义，须用 which。

examples.en: As we all know, the earth moves around the sun.
examples.zh: 众所周知，地球围绕太阳运行。
examples.note: as 在从句中作 know 的宾语，整个从句置于句首。

examples.en: As we all know it, the earth moves around the sun.
examples.zh: 众所周知，地球围绕太阳运行。
examples.note: as 已在从句中充当 know 的宾语，再加 it 会造成宾语重复。

examples.en: She is wearing the same dress as I bought last week.
examples.zh: 她穿着一条和我上周买的一样的裙子。
examples.note: the same...as 表示同类，不是同一件。

pitfalls.wrong: Which is known to all, practice makes perfect.
pitfalls.right: As is known to all, practice makes perfect.
pitfalls.why: which 从句不能出现在句首，句首指代整个主句只能用 as。

pitfalls.wrong: The company raised its prices again, as caused a wave of complaints.
pitfalls.right: The company raised its prices again, which caused a wave of complaints.
pitfalls.why: 从句说明主句造成的结果，属“这一点”的评论语义，as 只表“正如”，不能承担这一功能。

pitfalls.wrong: As we had expected it, the team won easily.
pitfalls.right: As we had expected, the team won easily.
pitfalls.why: as 在从句中已作 expected 的宾语，再加 it 会形成双重宾语。

contrast.withTitle: 关系代词 that 与 which 的区别
contrast.diff: 本知识点比较两个都能指代整个主句的词，判据是位置与语义；that 与 which 的分工发生在先行词为名词的限定性从句里，that 根本不进入非限定性结构。

concept.mnemonic: 句首只能用 as，评论结果用 which；as 译“正如”，which 译“这一点”。

core: 位置：as 可句首、句中、句末，which 只能跟在主句之后
语义：as 表“正如”（与主句一致、众所周知），which 表“这一点”（评论、结果）
固定搭配：as is well known / as we all know / as is often the case
which 常见谓语：which is why / which made / which shows
the same...that 指同一物，the same...as 指同类物
review.trigger: 看到逗号后指代整句 → 先看能否放到句首 → 再问语义是“正如”还是“这一点”

quickCheck.q: 句首指代整个主句用 as 还是 which？
He was late, ___ made the teacher angry. 填什么？
the same book as I bought 与 the same book that I bought 有何区别？
quickCheck.a: 前者是同类的另一本，后者是同一本。

drills.stem: ___ is often the case in winter, the roads become icy before dawn.
drills.answer: As
drills.explain: 空格位于句首并且指代整个主句，只有 as 能在句首引导这类非限定性从句。
drills.trap: Which 在语义上可以指代主句，但它引导的从句不能置于句首，这是位置判据的直接结果。

drills.stem: He failed to show up at the meeting, ___ made his colleagues rather annoyed.
drills.answer: which
drills.hint: 从句位于主句之后，说明这件事造成的后果。
drills.explain: 从句对主句事实作出评论并说明结果，属于“这一点”的语义，用 which 而不用 as。

drills.stem: Which is well known to all, the Yangtze is the longest river in China.
drills.answer: As is well known to all, the Yangtze is the longest river in China.
accept: As is well known to all, the Yangtze is the longest river in China.
drills.explain: 从句位于句首，which 不能放在主句之前，须换成 as，构成 as is well known to all。

drills.stem: The manager praised the whole team, ___ was exactly what we had hoped for.
drills.answer: which
drills.explain: 从句对主句事实作出“这正是我们所希望的”这类评论，属于 which 的“这一点”语义；that 不能引导非限定性从句。
drills.trap: as 表“正如”，要求从句内容与主句一致或为人熟知，与这里的评论语义不合。

drills.stem: 正如我们所预料的，比赛因大雨推迟了。
drills.answer: As we had expected, the match was postponed because of heavy rain.
drills.explain: 从句位于句首且表示“正如”，用 as；as 在从句中作 expected 的宾语，后面不能再加 it。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: As is often the case, students forget their passwords.
drills.explain: as 在从句中作主语，is often the case 是系表结构，从句置于句首，主句说明具体现象。

items.title: 关系副词 when/where/why 的选用
items.brief: 从句缺状语才用关系副词，缺主宾用代词

concept.summary: 关系副词只在从句缺状语时使用：把先行词代回从句，若需要补一个介词短语（on that day、in that city、for that reason）才能成句，就用 when、where、why；若代回后作主语或宾语，则必须用关系代词 which 或 that。三个关系副词分别等于 at/on/in which、at/in/on which 与 for which。

sections.h: 四步流程落到关系副词
sections.p: 前两步决定用代词还是副词，后两步决定用哪一个副词、以及能否改写成“介词 + which”。判定成分的唯一动作是把先行词代回原位置。
bullets: 第一步 先行词：时间名词 → when；地点或抽象“局面”名词 → where；reason → why
第二步 缺什么成分：主宾齐全、只缺状语 → 关系副词；缺主语或缺宾语 → 关系代词
第三步 限定性：非限定性从句同样可用 when/where，此时不能用 that 替代
第四步 介词：when = at/on/in which；where = at/in/on which；why = for which

sections.p: where 的先行词不限于具体地点。situation、case、point、stage、condition、atmosphere 这类表示局面、阶段、程度的名词后也用 where，因为从句同样缺一个地点状语，只是这个“地点”是抽象的。
bullets: We have reached a point where further discussion is pointless.
She grew up in an atmosphere where criticism was constant.
case / situation / stage / condition + where 是书面语高频结构

sections.p: 一是看到时间或地点名词就填关系副词，忽略从句缺的是宾语；二是把 The reason why... is because 当成正确结构，而 is 后面是表语从句，须用 that。
bullets: the day when we met（met 不及物，缺时间状语）；the day (that/which) we spent together（spent 缺宾语）
The reason why he resigned is that he found a better job.
why 的先行词只能是 reason，the cause why 不是规范搭配

examples.en: I still remember the afternoon when we first discussed the plan.
examples.zh: 我仍然记得我们第一次讨论这个计划的那个下午。
examples.note: 从句主宾齐全，只缺时间状语，用 when，等于 on which。

examples.en: I still remember the afternoon when we spent together in the old library.
examples.zh: 我仍然记得我们在旧图书馆一起度过的那个下午。
examples.note: spent 缺宾语，先行词在从句中作宾语，应改为 that 或 which，也可以省略。

examples.en: This is the village where my grandparents spent their whole lives.
examples.zh: 这就是我祖父母度过一生的村庄。
examples.note: spent 的宾语是 their whole lives，从句缺地点状语，用 where。

examples.en: This is the village where we visited last summer.
examples.zh: 这就是我们去年夏天参观的村庄。
examples.note: visited 缺宾语，先行词作 visited 的宾语，应改为 that 或 which。

examples.en: We have reached a point where further argument achieves nothing.
examples.zh: 我们已经到了再争论也没有用的地步。
examples.note: point 是抽象名词，从句缺地点状语，用 where。

examples.en: The reason why she left the company remains unclear.
examples.zh: 她离开公司的原因仍不清楚。
examples.note: 先行词 reason 加从句缺原因状语，用 why，等于 for which。

examples.en: The reason because she left the company remains unclear.
examples.zh: 她离开公司的原因仍不清楚。
examples.note: because 不能引导定语从句，原因状语由 why 或 for which 承担。

pitfalls.wrong: This is the museum where we visited yesterday.
pitfalls.right: This is the museum that we visited yesterday.
pitfalls.why: visited 是及物动词，从句缺的是宾语而不是地点状语，先行词代回后作宾语，须用关系代词。

pitfalls.wrong: The reason why he was absent is because he was ill.
pitfalls.right: The reason why he was absent is that he was ill.
pitfalls.why: why 从句是定语从句，is 后面是表语从句，表语从句用 that 引导，because 只能引导状语从句。

pitfalls.wrong: I will never forget the days when I spent in Beijing.
pitfalls.right: I will never forget the days that I spent in Beijing.
pitfalls.why: spend 需要宾语，先行词 the days 在从句中作 spent 的宾语，因此用关系代词。

contrast.withTitle: 介词 + 关系代词结构
contrast.diff: 关系副词是“介词 + which”的压缩形式，先行词明确时优先用 when/where/why；需要突出具体介词或先行词有固定搭配时，才展开成“介词 + which”。

concept.mnemonic: 先代回、再看缺：缺状语用副词，缺主宾用代词；when=on which，where=in which，why=for which。

core: 判据：把先行词代回从句，缺状语用关系副词，缺主宾用关系代词
when = at/on/in which；where = at/in/on which；why = for which
where 可用于 point、case、situation、stage 等抽象名词后
why 的先行词只能是 reason，表语从句用 that 不用 because
时间、地点名词后并非一律用关系副词，先检验成分
review.trigger: 看到时间、地点、reason 名词 → 把先行词代回从句 → 缺状语才填 when/where/why

quickCheck.q: the village ___ we visited last year 填什么？
quickCheck.a: that 或 which，visited 缺宾语。

quickCheck.q: why 等于哪个介词短语？
The reason why he left is ___ he was ill. 填什么？

drills.stem: We have reached a stage ___ any further delay would ruin the whole project.
drills.answer: where
drills.explain: 从句 any further delay would ruin the whole project 主宾齐全，只缺一个抽象的地点状语，stage 后用 where。
drills.trap: which 和 that 在从句中必须作主语或宾语，而本句从句结构已经完整，填进去没有成分可承担。

drills.stem: I will never forget the day ___ I first stood on a stage.
drills.answer: when
drills.hint: 从句 stood on a stage 结构完整，缺的是时间状语。
drills.explain: 先行词是表示时间的 the day，从句不缺主语和宾语，只缺时间状语，用 when 或 on which。

drills.stem: This is the factory where we visited last week.
drills.answer: This is the factory that we visited last week.
accept: This is the factory that we visited last week.
This is the factory which we visited last week.
drills.explain: visited 是及物动词，需要宾语，先行词 the factory 在从句中作宾语，因此用 that 或 which 而不是 where。

drills.stem: The reason ___ he gave for his absence sounded convincing.
drills.answer: that
drills.explain: gave 缺少宾语，先行词 the reason 在从句中作 gave 的宾语，属于缺主宾的情形，用关系代词 that。
drills.trap: why 要求从句缺原因状语，而本句从句缺的是宾语，先行词不是状语成分。

drills.stem: 我们已经到了无法回头的地步。
drills.answer: We have reached a point where there is no turning back.
drills.explain: point 是抽象名词，后面的从句 there is no turning back 结构完整，只缺抽象地点状语，用 where。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: This is the town where my mother was born.
drills.explain: was born 是被动结构，后面不需要宾语，从句只缺地点状语，因此用 where。

items.title: 介词 + 关系代词结构
items.brief: 介词后只接 whom 或 which，介词看搭配

concept.summary: 介词提到关系词之前时，指人只能用 whom，指物只能用 which，that 与 who 一律不行。介词选哪一个由三条线索决定：从句中动词的固定搭配、从句中形容词的搭配、先行词本身的常用搭配。介词留在句末时，关系词可用 that，也可以省略。

sections.p: 四步流程照常走，只是第四步在这里权重最大：介词一旦提前，关系词的形式就被锁死，只有 whom 与 which 两个选项。此时“介词 + 关系词”整体在从句中作状语，从句其余部分必须完整。
bullets: 第一步 先行词：指人 → whom；指物 → which
第二步 缺什么成分：介词 + 关系词整体作状语，其余成分齐全
第三步 限定性：非限定性从句中同样可用，逗号位置不变
第四步 介词：动词搭配、形容词搭配、先行词搭配三条线索决定

sections.p: 介词不是凭语感挑的，而是从原句的搭配里搬过来的。先把从句还原成独立句，看动词或形容词原本带什么介词，再把这个介词提到关系词前。
bullets: 动词搭配：the problem (which) we talked about → the problem about which we talked
形容词搭配：the conditions (which) we are accustomed to → the conditions to which we are accustomed
先行词搭配：the extent to which / the degree to which / the rate at which / the way in which

sections.p: some、many、most、all、both、none、each 加 of whom/which，以及 the + 名词 + of which，是书面语常见结构，通常出现在逗号之后，表示整体中的一部分或所属关系。
bullets: The committee has twelve members, most of whom are lawyers.
He wrote several novels, two of which were adapted for film.
a theory the origin of which is obscure

examples.en: The problem about which we argued for hours was finally solved.
examples.zh: 我们争论了好几个小时的那个问题终于解决了。
examples.note: argue about 是固定搭配，介词提前后指物用 which。

examples.en: The problem about that we argued for hours was finally solved.
examples.zh: 我们争论了好几个小时的那个问题终于解决了。
examples.note: 介词后不能使用 that，指物只能用 which。

examples.en: The colleague with whom I share an office is on holiday.
examples.zh: 与我共用一间办公室的同事正在休假。
examples.note: share sth with sb，介词 with 提前后指人用宾语 whom。

examples.en: The colleague with who I share an office is on holiday.
examples.zh: 与我共用一间办公室的同事正在休假。
examples.note: 介词 with 后必须用宾格 whom，who 不能作介词宾语。

examples.en: The committee has twelve members, most of whom are lawyers.
examples.zh: 委员会有十二名成员，其中大多数是律师。
examples.note: most of whom 是数量词 + of + 宾格结构，用于非限定性从句。

examples.en: He wrote several novels, two of which were adapted for film.
examples.zh: 他写了好几部小说，其中两部被改编成电影。
examples.note: two of which 指物，of 后只能用 which。

examples.en: The rate in that the rainforest is disappearing worries scientists.
examples.zh: 雨林消失的速度令科学家担忧。
examples.note: 介词 in 提前后只能用 which，that 不能作介词宾语。

pitfalls.wrong: The tool with that he repaired the engine is missing.
pitfalls.right: The tool with which he repaired the engine is missing.
pitfalls.why: 介词 with 提前，指物只能用 which；that 不能出现在介词之后。

pitfalls.wrong: She is the teacher from who I learned the most.
pitfalls.right: She is the teacher from whom I learned the most.
pitfalls.why: learn from sb 的介词提前，指人须用宾格 whom，主格 who 不能作介词宾语。

pitfalls.wrong: The lecture which we listened was rather dull.
pitfalls.right: The lecture to which we listened was rather dull.
pitfalls.why: listen 是不及物动词，必须带介词 to；关系词提前时介词不能丢。

contrast.withTitle: 关系副词 when/where/why 的选用
contrast.diff: 关系副词是固定的“介词 + which”合并形式（when=on which）；本知识点处理介词需要按搭配自由选择的场合，以及数量词 + of which/whom 这类结构。

concept.mnemonic: 介词在前只认两个：人 whom，物 which；介词选谁看搭配，动词、形容词、先行词。

core: 介词提前后只接 whom（人）与 which（物），that 与 who 都不能用
介词由动词搭配、形容词搭配、先行词搭配三条线索决定
介词留在句末时，关系词可用 that 或省略，语义不变
数量词 + of whom/which 表整体中的一部分，多用于非限定性从句
不及物动词的介词不能丢，否则从句成分残缺
review.trigger: 看到空格前有介词 → 先看先行词指人还是指物 → 再回原句找动词或形容词原本的介词

quickCheck.q: 介词后面能用 that 吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，只能用 which 或 whom。

quickCheck.q: the rate ___ which 填什么介词？
quickCheck.a: at，at the rate 是固定搭配。

quickCheck.q: most of ___ are lawyers，先行词是成员时填什么？

drills.stem: The method ___ the team solved the problem was surprisingly simple.
drills.answer: by which
drills.explain: solve the problem by a method 是固定搭配，介词 by 提前后指物用 which，by which 在从句中作方式状语。
drills.trap: 只填 which 会让 solved 缺少方式状语；by that 则违反了介词后不能用 that 的规则。

drills.stem: She is the professor from ___ I learned most of what I know about linguistics.
drills.answer: whom
drills.hint: learn from sb，介词 from 已经提前。
drills.explain: learn from sb 的介词 from 提到关系词前，指人必须用宾格 whom。

drills.stem: The tool with that he repaired the engine is missing.
drills.answer: The tool with which he repaired the engine is missing.
accept: The tool with which he repaired the engine is missing.
drills.explain: repair sth with a tool 的介词 with 已提前，指物的介词宾语只能用 which，that 不能出现在介词之后。

drills.stem: The company employs three hundred workers, forty ___ are qualified engineers.
drills.answer: of whom
drills.explain: 先行词 workers 指人，数量词 + of + 关系词构成非限定性从句，介词 of 后必须用宾格 whom。
drills.trap: of them 会让逗号后变成独立分句，构成逗号拼接；of who 则是介词后误用主格。

drills.stem: 我们争论了好几个小时的那个问题终于解决了。
drills.answer: The problem about which we argued for hours was finally solved.
drills.explain: argue about sth 的介词 about 提到关系词前，指物用 which；关系词已作 about 的宾语，从句中不能再加 it。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The house in which she grew up has been sold.
drills.explain: grow up in a house 的介词 in 提前，指物用 which；主句谓语 has been sold 与主语 the house 一致。

items.title: 限制性与非限制性定语从句
items.brief: 逗号决定从句能否删除，也决定能否用 that

concept.summary: 限定性从句与先行词结合成一个整体，删掉后主句指代不清；非限定性从句只补充信息，用逗号隔开，删掉后主句仍成立。判定用删除测试：去掉从句，看主句是否还能明确指认对象。非限定性从句不能用 that，关系词不能省略，which 还可指代整个主句。

sections.h: 删除测试与两类先行词
sections.p: 删除测试是唯一可靠的判据，不看逗号先看语义：去掉从句后主句所指是否改变。先行词本身已经唯一（专有名词、my/this 限定、独一无二事物）时，从句只能是补充信息。
bullets: 删除后指代不明 → 限定性：The students who failed the test must retake it.
删除后仍明确 → 非限定性：My brother, who lives in Berlin, is a translator.
专有名词、独一无二事物、my/this/最高级等唯一性限定之后 → 非限定性
泛指一类人或物的整体陈述 → 非限定性：Elephants, which are the largest land animals, live in herds.

sections.h: 非限定性的三条形式要求
sections.p: 四步选词流程的第三步就落在这里：限定性一旦排除，that 也随之排除，同时关系词不能再省。三条要求互相关联，本质是同一条——非限定性从句是独立的补充成分。
bullets: 逗号：从句前后加逗号，位于句末时前面加逗号
关系词：不能用 that；指人用 who/whom，指物用 which
省略：关系词即使作宾语也不能省略

sections.h: 语义差别与 which 指代整句
sections.p: 同一先行词加不加逗号，句子的预设完全不同。非限制性从句中的 which 还可以指代前面整个主句，这时不能换成 that。
bullets: The students who passed were praised.（只有通过的学生受表扬）
The students, who passed, were praised.（全体学生都通过了，因此都受表扬）
He failed the exam, which surprised nobody.

examples.en: My father, who works in a bank, retires next month.
examples.zh: 我父亲在银行工作，下个月退休。
examples.note: 先行词由 my 限定已唯一，从句只补充信息，用逗号隔开。

examples.en: My father, that works in a bank, retires next month.
examples.zh: 我父亲在银行工作，下个月退休。
examples.note: 非限定性从句不能用 that，指人应改为 who。

examples.en: The students who failed the test must retake it in September.
examples.zh: 考试不及格的学生必须在九月补考。
examples.note: 限定性从句说明“哪些学生”，删掉后主句所指改变。

examples.en: The students, who had all passed the test, were given certificates.
examples.zh: 这些学生全都通过了考试，都拿到了证书。
examples.note: 非限定性从句补充说明全体学生都通过了，删掉不影响主句成立。

examples.en: He introduced me to his editor, that had worked with him for years.
examples.zh: 他把我介绍给了他的编辑，那位编辑与他合作多年。
examples.note: 逗号后的非限定性从句不能用 that，指人应改为 who。

examples.en: She arrived an hour late, which made the interviewer impatient.
examples.zh: 她迟到了一个小时，这让面试官很不耐烦。
examples.note: which 指代整个主句，非限定性从句作补充评论。

examples.en: The book, I borrowed from the library, is overdue.
examples.zh: 我从图书馆借的那本书逾期了。
examples.note: 非限定性从句的关系词作宾语也不能省略，应补上 which。

pitfalls.wrong: Beijing, that is the capital of China, attracts millions of tourists.
pitfalls.right: Beijing, which is the capital of China, attracts millions of tourists.
pitfalls.why: 专有名词后只能是非限定性从句，而非限定性从句不允许 that。

pitfalls.wrong: My uncle, that I visited last summer, lives in a village.
pitfalls.right: My uncle, whom I visited last summer, lives in a village.
pitfalls.why: 非限定性从句不能用 that；关系词作 visited 的宾语，正式文体用 whom。

pitfalls.wrong: He passed the exam, that delighted his parents.
pitfalls.right: He passed the exam, which delighted his parents.
pitfalls.why: 指代整个主句只能用 which，且非限定性从句不能用 that。

contrast.withTitle: 定语从句与其他从句的辨识
contrast.diff: 本知识点解决“加不加逗号、能不能用 that”；辨识知识点解决“这个从句到底是不是定语从句”，判据是有无先行词以及关系词是否充当成分。

concept.mnemonic: 能删的是补充，有逗号不用 that；不能删的是限定，删了主句就说不清。

core: 判据：删除从句，主句是否还能明确指认对象
限定性：无逗号，可用 that，作宾语的关系词可省略
非限定性：有逗号，不用 that，关系词不能省略
专有名词、唯一性限定、整体类指之后用非限定性
同一先行词加不加逗号，句子的预设完全不同
review.trigger: 看到逗号 + 关系词 → 先做删除测试 → 排除 that 并检查关系词有没有被省略

quickCheck.q: 非限定性从句能用 that 吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，指人用 who，指物用 which。

quickCheck.q: The students, who passed, were praised. 说明多少人通过？
非限定性从句作宾语时关系词能省略吗？

drills.stem: My grandfather, ___ fought in the war, never talked about it.
drills.answer: who
drills.explain: 逗号之间是非限定性从句，不能用 that；关系词在从句中作 fought 的主语，指人用 who。
drills.trap: that 是最强干扰项，它在限定性从句中常替代 who，但非限定性从句一律排除 that。

drills.stem: The volunteers, most of ___ had no medical training, worked around the clock.
drills.answer: whom
drills.hint: 先行词 the volunteers 指人，空格前是介词 of。
drills.explain: 非限定性从句中数量词 + of + 关系词，先行词指人，介词后必须用宾格 whom。

drills.stem: The Great Wall, that runs across northern China, was built over many centuries.
drills.answer: The Great Wall, which runs across northern China, was built over many centuries.
accept: The Great Wall, which runs across northern China, was built over many centuries.
drills.explain: 专有名词后的逗号从句属非限定性，that 不能引导非限定性从句，指物改用 which。

drills.stem: The players who were injured were replaced at half time. 这句话的意思是：
options: 只有受伤的球员被替换下场
所有球员都受伤了，因此全被替换
球员们拒绝被替换下场
drills.answer: 只有受伤的球员被替换下场
drills.explain: 句中 who were injured 前没有逗号，是限定性从句，用来限定 the players 的范围，说明被替换的只是受伤的那部分。
drills.trap: 若读成“所有球员”，等于把从句当非限定性，但非限定性必须有逗号，本句没有。

drills.stem: 我哥哥住在柏林，他是一名翻译。
drills.answer: My brother, who lives in Berlin, is a translator.
drills.explain: 先行词由 my 限定已唯一，从句只是补充信息，须用逗号隔开并采用 who，不能用 that。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: My brother, who lives in Berlin, is a translator.
drills.explain: 非限定性从句前后各有一个逗号，关系词 who 不能省略，主句是 My brother is a translator。

items.title: 定语从句中的主谓一致
items.brief: 从句谓语跟先行词，不跟紧邻的名词

concept.summary: 定语从句谓语动词的单复数由先行词决定，与从句中紧邻谓语的词无关。判定分两步：先定位先行词，再看它是单数还是复数。one of + 复数名词 + 关系词后用复数谓语；the only one of + 复数名词 + 关系词后用单数谓语。

sections.p: 选词流程的第二步确定关系词之后，才轮到谓语的形式。第一步永远是定位先行词：关系词前面的那个名词，而不是从句里离谓语最近的名词，也不是主句的主语。
bullets: 第一步 定位先行词：关系词前面的名词性成分
第二步 定数：先行词单数 → 从句谓语单数；先行词复数 → 从句谓语复数
The books on the shelf which was bought last week... 中 which 的先行词是 shelf，不是 books

sections.h: one of 与 the only one of
sections.p: 这两个结构是核心考点，差别只在 only 一词：加了 only，先行词从复数名词收缩为单数的 one，从句谓语随之变单数。
bullets: He is one of the students who have won the scholarship.（先行词 students）
He is the only one of the students who has won the scholarship.（先行词 one）
This is one of the problems that remain unsolved.

sections.p: 先行词本身的数不由形式决定，而由语义决定：集合名词看强调整体还是成员，数量短语看中心词，which 指代整句时按单数处理。
bullets: 集合名词 the team / the family / the government：强调整体用单数，强调成员用复数
each / every / either / neither + 单数名词 → 从句谓语单数
the number of + 复数名词 → 单数；a number of + 复数名词 → 复数
which 指代整个主句时，从句谓语用单数：He came late, which annoys everyone.

examples.en: She is one of the few women who have won that prize.
examples.zh: 她是少数获得该奖项的女性之一。
examples.note: one of + 复数名词结构中先行词是 women，从句谓语用复数 have。

examples.en: She is one of the few women who has won that prize.
examples.zh: 她是少数获得该奖项的女性之一。
examples.note: one of 后先行词是复数名词 women，从句谓语须用复数。

examples.en: He is the only one of the applicants who has passed the interview.
examples.zh: 他是申请者中唯一通过面试的人。
examples.note: the only one of 把先行词限定为单数的 one，从句谓语用单数 has。

examples.en: He is the only one of the applicants who have passed the interview.
examples.zh: 他是申请者中唯一通过面试的人。
examples.note: only 限定了先行词为单数的 one，从句谓语须用 has。

examples.en: The number of students who study abroad has risen steadily.
examples.zh: 出国留学的学生人数稳步上升。
examples.note: 从句先行词是复数 students，用 study；主句主语 the number 为单数，用 has。

examples.en: The books on the top shelf, which was built into the wall, are rare editions.
examples.zh: 顶层书架上的书都是珍本，那个书架是嵌在墙里的。
examples.note: which 的先行词是 shelf 而非 books，从句谓语用单数 was。

examples.en: Anyone who want to join the trip should sign up by Friday.
examples.zh: 想参加这次旅行的人应在周五前报名。
examples.note: 先行词 anyone 为单数，从句谓语应为 wants。

pitfalls.wrong: Tom is one of the boys who has joined the club.
pitfalls.right: Tom is one of the boys who have joined the club.
pitfalls.why: one of 结构中先行词是复数名词 boys，从句谓语与 boys 一致用复数。

pitfalls.wrong: She is the only one of the students who have read the whole novel.
pitfalls.right: She is the only one of the students who has read the whole novel.
pitfalls.why: the only one of 把先行词收回单数的 one，从句谓语随之变为单数。

pitfalls.wrong: The price of the houses that was built last year has doubled.
pitfalls.right: The price of the houses that were built last year has doubled.
pitfalls.why: that 的先行词是 houses，不是紧邻的 last year，也不是主句主语 price。

contrast.diff: 语法一致处理主句主语与谓语的关系；定语从句的一致多了一步定位——先找到先行词，再套用同一条一致原则。

concept.mnemonic: 先找先行词，再定单复数；one of 用复数，the only one of 用单数。

core: 从句谓语与先行词一致，不与紧邻名词一致
one of + 复数名词 + 关系词 → 复数谓语
the only one of + 复数名词 + 关系词 → 单数谓语
集合名词看语义：整体单数，成员复数
the number of 用单数，a number of 用复数；which 指代整句用单数
review.trigger: 看到定语从句里的谓语 → 先往前找关系词 → 再往前锁定先行词 → 最后定单复数

quickCheck.q: He is one of the students who ___ (be) late. 填什么？
the only one of 结构从句谓语用单数还是复数？
which 指代整个主句时谓语用什么？

drills.stem: She is one of the engineers who ___ worked on the new engine.
drills.answer: have
drills.explain: one of + 复数名词结构中，关系词的先行词是复数名词 engineers，从句谓语用复数 have。
drills.trap: has 是受紧邻的 one 干扰而误判，先行词不在 one 上。

drills.stem: He is the only one of the candidates who ___ (speak) three languages fluently.
drills.answer: speaks
drills.hint: 注意 the only one of 已经把先行词限定为单数。
drills.explain: the only one of 结构中先行词是单数的 one，从句谓语用第三人称单数 speaks。

drills.stem: Tom is one of the boys who has joined the drama club.
drills.answer: Tom is one of the boys who have joined the drama club.
accept: Tom is one of the boys who have joined the drama club.
drills.explain: one of 结构的先行词是复数名词 boys，从句谓语须与 boys 一致，用 have joined。

drills.stem: The number of people who ___ online every day keeps growing.
drills.answer: shop
drills.explain: 从句的先行词是复数名词 people，谓语用 shop；主句主语 the number 才是单数，由 keeps 承担。
drills.trap: shops 是误把主句主语 the number 当作从句先行词，两个谓语因此都被写成单数。

drills.stem: 他是唯一一个通过这场考试的学生。
drills.answer: He is the only one of the students who has passed the exam.
drills.explain: the only one of 把先行词限定为单数的 one，从句谓语用 has passed；若说 one of the students，谓语才用 have。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The number of students who study abroad is rising.
drills.explain: 从句先行词是复数 students，谓语用 study；主句主语是 the number，谓语用 is。

items.title: 定语从句与其他从句的辨识
items.brief: 先行词加成分双重检验，判断从句性质

concept.summary: 判定是不是定语从句用两道检验：一看从句前有没有名词性先行词，二看引导词在从句里是否充当成分。两条都成立是定语从句；引导词只连接、不作成分，且从句内容就是前面抽象名词的内容，是同位语从句；从句前没有先行词、修饰主句谓语，是状语从句。

sections.h: 定语从句与同位语从句
sections.p: 两类从句都跟在抽象名词后，区别在 that 是否在从句中作成分，以及从句是不是该名词的内容。这一点必须先于选词流程的第一步完成：定性不对，后面缺主、缺宾的判断全部落空。
bullets: The news that he told us was false.（that 作 told 的宾语 → 定语从句）
The news that our team had won spread quickly.（that 不作成分，从句就是 news 的内容 → 同位语从句）
检验：能说 The news is that... 成立 → 同位语从句
which 与 who 不能引导同位语从句，同位语从句的引导词限于 that、whether 等
流程位置：先确认有没有先行词、引导词占不占成分，再进入“先行词 → 成分 → 限定性 → 介词”四步

sections.p: where 与 when 两类引导词都能出现在两种从句里，区别是有没有先行词。有先行词、从句修饰该名词 → 定语从句；没有先行词、从句修饰主句谓语 → 状语从句。
bullets: Put the box where you can reach it.（地点状语从句，无先行词）
Put the box in the place where you can reach it.（定语从句，先行词是 the place）
I will call you when I arrive.（时间状语从句）；I still remember the day when we met.（定语从句）

sections.p: 强调句的结构是 It is/was + 被强调部分 + that，去掉这一框架后句子仍然完整。定语从句的 that 可以换成 which 而句意不变，强调句的 that 不能换成 which，这是第二条可操作的检验。
bullets: It was in 1990 that the bridge was built.（去掉框架后 In 1990 the bridge was built. 成立 → 强调句）
It was the bridge that was built in 1990.（that 可换成 which → 定语从句）
强调句中被强调的成分可以是状语，定语从句的关系词永远不能充当被强调成分

examples.en: The news that he told us turned out to be false.
examples.zh: 他告诉我们的那个消息结果是假的。
examples.note: that 在从句中作 told 的宾语，从句修饰 news，是定语从句。

examples.en: The news that the factory would close spread through the town.
examples.zh: 工厂将要关闭的消息传遍了全镇。
examples.note: that 不作成分，从句内容就是 news 本身，是同位语从句。

examples.en: The news which the factory would close spread through the town.
examples.zh: 工厂将要关闭的消息传遍了全镇。
examples.note: 从句说明 news 的内容且不缺成分，须用 that 引导同位语从句，which 不能这样用。

examples.en: She put the documents where the manager could find them.
examples.zh: 她把文件放在经理能找到的地方。
examples.note: 没有先行词，where 从句修饰 put 的地点，是地点状语从句。

examples.en: She put the documents in the drawer where the manager could find them.
examples.zh: 她把文件放在经理能找到的那个抽屉里。
examples.note: 有先行词 the drawer，where 从句修饰它，是定语从句。

examples.en: I will never forget the days when I spent in the countryside.
examples.zh: 我永远不会忘记在乡下度过的那些日子。
examples.note: spent 缺宾语，先行词在从句中作宾语，应改为 that 或 which。

examples.en: The reason because he gave sounded convincing.
examples.zh: 他给出的理由听起来很有说服力。
examples.note: because 不能引导定语从句；先行词在从句中作 gave 的宾语，应用 that 或 which。

pitfalls.wrong: The fact which she had resigned surprised nobody.
pitfalls.right: The fact that she had resigned surprised nobody.
pitfalls.why: 从句结构完整、内容就是 fact 本身，属同位语从句，只能用 that 引导。

pitfalls.wrong: This is the house where he was born in.
pitfalls.right: This is the house where he was born.
pitfalls.why: where 已包含 in which，句末再加 in 会造成介词重复。

pitfalls.wrong: It was in the library where I first met her.
pitfalls.right: It was in the library that I first met her.
pitfalls.why: 被强调的是地点状语 in the library，强调句的框架固定用 that，where 不能替代。

contrast.withTitle: 状语从句与定语从句的辨析
contrast.diff: 本知识点用先行词与成分两条检验给从句定性；该辨析专攻 where/when 类引导词在两类从句中的分工与语义差别。

concept.mnemonic: 有先行词、引导词作成分 → 定语从句；只连接不作成分 → 同位语；没有先行词 → 状语从句。

core: 两道检验：有无名词性先行词，引导词在从句中是否充当成分
同位语从句的 that 不作成分，从句内容等于前面抽象名词的内容
which 与 who 不能引导同位语从句
where/when 前有先行词是定语从句，无先行词是状语从句
强调句去掉 It is/was 与 that 后句子仍完整，且 that 不能换成 which
review.trigger: 看到抽象名词后的 that 或 where/when → 先查先行词 → 再把引导词代回从句看它占不占成分

quickCheck.q: The news that he told me 中 that 作什么成分？
quickCheck.a: 作 told 的宾语，所以是定语从句。

quickCheck.q: 同位语从句能用 which 引导吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，只能用 that、whether 等。

quickCheck.q: It was in 1990 ___ the bridge was built. 填什么？

drills.stem: The news ___ the company was closing down spread within an hour.
drills.answer: that
drills.explain: 从句结构完整，内容就是 news 本身，属于同位语从句，只能用 that 引导。
drills.trap: which 在从句中必须充当主语或宾语，而本句从句主宾齐全，which 没有成分可以承担。

drills.stem: She hid the letter in a place ___ nobody would think of looking.
drills.answer: where
drills.hint: 空格前有先行词 a place。
drills.explain: a place 是先行词，从句缺地点状语，用 where 或 in which 引导定语从句。

drills.stem: The fact which she had never learned to swim surprised her classmates.
drills.answer: The fact that she had never learned to swim surprised her classmates.
accept: The fact that she had never learned to swim surprised her classmates.
drills.explain: 从句不缺主语也不缺宾语，内容就是 fact 本身，属于同位语从句，引导词只能用 that。

drills.stem: It was in the small café ___ they first discussed the business plan.
drills.answer: that
drills.explain: 去掉 It was 与空格后的部分，In the small café they first discussed the business plan 仍然成立，说明这是强调句，框架词用 that。
drills.trap: where 会让句子读成“咖啡馆里讨论”，但此处被强调的是地点状语 in the small café，强调句不能用 where。

drills.stem: 他辞职的消息让所有人感到意外。
drills.answer: The news that he had resigned surprised everyone.
drills.explain: 从句说明 news 的内容且不缺成分，是同位语从句，用 that 引导；what 自带先行词，不能与 news 并用。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The news that our team had won spread quickly.
drills.explain: that 从句内容即 news 本身，是同位语从句；主句谓语 spread 与主语 the news 搭配。

items.title: 定语从句的简化
items.brief: 关系词作主语才能压成分词短语

concept.summary: 定语从句简化的前提是关系词在从句中作主语。主动语态改为现在分词，被动语态改为过去分词，系表结构可省略 be 只留表语。关系词作宾语时不能压成分词短语，只能省略关系词保留从句，或改用不定式表示将来与顺序。

sections.p: 简化发生在选词流程之后：先按流程确定关系词与成分，关系词作主语才谈得上压缩。压缩时删掉关系词与 be，再用分词承担原谓语的动作。
bullets: 第一步 看关系词在从句中作什么成分：作主语才能简化成分词短语
第二步 判断主动还是被动：主动 → 现在分词；被动 → 过去分词
第三步 检查逻辑主语：分词短语的逻辑主语必须就是先行词
The bridge which was built in 1990 → the bridge built in 1990
The students who are studying abroad → the students studying abroad

sections.p: 关系词作宾语时，从句主语与先行词不一致，无法压成分词短语。此时只有两种处理：省略关系词保留从句，或用不定式改写。
bullets: The book (which) I bought yesterday is a classic.（省略关系词，从句保留）
He was the first man who walked on the moon. → He was the first man to walk on the moon.
序数词、最高级、the only 之后的定语从句常简化为不定式

sections.p: 三类情况必须保留从句：从句含情态动词表推测或虚拟；从句时态与主句不在同一时间平面（完成、将来）；非限定性从句简化后会失去补充说明的独立性。
bullets: the man who might have seen her 不能压成 the man having seen her
the questions that will be discussed tomorrow 常保留从句或用 to be discussed
非限定性从句在正式写作中一般保留，避免信息层级被压平

examples.en: The bridge built in 1990 is still in use.
examples.zh: 1990 年建成的那座桥仍在使用。
examples.note: 原从句 which was built 为被动，简化后保留过去分词 built。

examples.en: The bridge building in 1990 is still in use.
examples.zh: 1990 年建成的那座桥仍在使用。
examples.note: bridge 与 build 是被动关系，应用过去分词 built；现在分词表主动。

examples.en: The students studying abroad will return next month.
examples.zh: 在国外学习的那些学生下个月回国。
examples.note: 原从句 who are studying 为主动进行，简化为现在分词短语。

examples.en: The students studied abroad will return next month.
examples.zh: 在国外学习的那些学生下个月回国。
examples.note: 学生是学习行为的发出者，主动关系须用现在分词 studying，过去分词表被动。

examples.en: Anyone wishing to join the club should fill in this form.
examples.zh: 想加入俱乐部的人应填写这张表。
examples.note: who wishes 简化为现在分词 wishing，逻辑主语 anyone 与先行词一致。

examples.en: She was the first woman to win the prize.
examples.zh: 她是第一位获得该奖项的女性。
examples.note: 序数词 first 后的定语从句简化为不定式 to win。

examples.en: The novel writing by Lu Xun in 1921 is still widely read.
examples.zh: 鲁迅1921 年写的那部小说至今仍被广泛阅读。
examples.note: novel 与 write 是被动关系，应用过去分词 written。

pitfalls.wrong: The man walked along the river is my uncle.
pitfalls.right: The man walking along the river is my uncle.
pitfalls.why: man 是 walk 的执行者，主动关系须用现在分词 walking；过去分词表被动或完成。

pitfalls.wrong: The report publishing last week caused a stir.
pitfalls.right: The report published last week caused a stir.
pitfalls.why: report 与 publish 是被动关系，简化时用过去分词 published。

pitfalls.wrong: The questions that discussed at the meeting remain open.
pitfalls.right: The questions discussed at the meeting remain open.
pitfalls.why: 简化时关系词与 be 必须一起删除；只删 be 会留下 that + 过去分词这种残缺结构。

contrast.diff: 本知识点处理从句到短语的转换，先有从句再压缩；分词作定语处理短语内部主动与被动的选择，两者共用“逻辑主语 + 主动/被动”这一条判据。

concept.mnemonic: 主语位置才能压：主动 -ing，被动 -ed；宾语位置只能省，序数最高用 to do。

core: 前提：关系词在从句中作主语，才能简化成分词短语
主动用现在分词，被动用过去分词，系表结构省略 be
关系词作宾语时只省略关系词，或改用不定式
序数词、最高级、the only 之后常用不定式
情态、将来、非限定性从句一般保留原句
review.trigger: 看到 who/which + be + 分词或形容词 → 试着删掉关系词与 be → 再核对逻辑主语与主动被动

quickCheck.q: the bridge which was built 简化后是什么？
关系词作宾语时能压成分词短语吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，只能省略关系词或用不定式。

quickCheck.q: the first man who walked on the moon 怎么简化？
quickCheck.a: the first man to walk on the moon。

drills.stem: The problems ___ at yesterday's meeting remain unsolved.
drills.answer: discussed
drills.explain: problems 与 discuss 是被动关系，简化 which were discussed 后保留过去分词 discussed。
drills.trap: discussing 表主动，等于问题在讨论别人，与 problems 的逻辑关系相反。

drills.stem: The girl ___ (sing) on the stage is my cousin.
drills.answer: singing
drills.hint: 女孩与唱歌是主动关系。
drills.explain: 原从句 who is singing 为主动进行，简化后去掉关系词与 be，保留现在分词 singing。

drills.stem: The bridge building in 1990 is still in use.
drills.answer: The bridge built in 1990 is still in use.
accept: The bridge built in 1990 is still in use.
drills.explain: 桥是被建造的对象，与 build 构成被动关系，简化 which was built 时须用过去分词 built。

drills.stem: He was the first scientist ___ a vaccine against the disease.
drills.answer: to develop
drills.explain: 先行词被序数词 first 修饰，定语从句常简化为不定式，表示“第一个做某事的人”。
drills.trap: developing 表示正在研发，与“第一个研制出”的完成意义不符；who develop 主谓不一致。

drills.stem: 这座用竹子建成的桥已经有一百年历史了。
drills.answer: The bridge built of bamboo is already a hundred years old.
drills.explain: 桥与 build 是被动关系，which was built of bamboo 简化为过去分词短语 built of bamboo。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The students studying abroad will return next month.
drills.explain: who are studying abroad 简化为现在分词短语 studying abroad，逻辑主语 students 与先行词一致。
